name: What preparation is needed before kitchen drywall installation begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before kitchen drywall installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text:
How do I prepare my kitchen before drywall installers arrive?
Before drywall work begins, confirm that all rough-in electrical, plumbing, ductwork, and structural inspections are signed off. Mark all stud locations and make sure wood backing is fastened in place for wall-hung cabinets, microwaves, and floating shelves. Clear out all personal items, cover adjacent rooms or dining areas with plastic sheeting to contain dust, and establish an unobstructed path for moving large drywall sheets into the house. Documenting wire and pipe runs with photos before walls close up is also highly recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pass all rough inspections, install cabinet blocking, photograph open wall cavities, and clear furniture and pathways to prepare for drywall delivery and hanging.
